unpack_chemistry_and_rotation: unpack a WorldEvent to extract chemistry constraints and rotation mapping from a ChemistryCreated event
unpack_potion_used: unpack a WorldEvent to get the potion instance ID and stone instance ID from a PotionUsed event
get_stones: extract a list of PerceivedStone objects with instance IDs from StoneCreated events in a sequence
get_potions: extract a list of PerceivedPotion objects with instance IDs from PotionCreated events in a sequence
events_per_trial: split a trajectory of WorldEvents into separate lists grouped by trial start and end boundaries
